args.message:
Bump fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

CVE-2026-31337 (high) is an unbounded recursion issue when parsing
deeply nested arrays. Affected: fastjson <2.9.4. Upgrading to 2.9.4,
the fixed release on the same major version line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-CVE-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 → 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the `fastjson` dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address **CVE-2026-31337**.

## Security advisory
- **CVE-2026-31337** (high): Unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: `>=2.0.0 <2.9.4` (and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`)
- Fixed in: 2.9.4 and 3.1.0

We chose **2.9.4**, the patched release on the same major version line, to avoid the breaking changes that would come with jumping to the 3.x series. This is the minimal, safe upgrade path.

## Testing
CI has been run on this branch and passed (`ci-0001`).

## Reviewer
Requested review from @alex.
